column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be —

column2: to  unite  all  visually  handicapped  people  living  in
Sri Lanka ;
to  provide  welfare  services  to  the  visually
handicapped and to seek solutions to common and
individual  problems  confronted  by  the  visually
handicapped  community;
to  inform  the  State  and  other  organisations  with
regard to common and individual issues confronted
by the visually handicapped community ;
to create awareness among the visually handicapped
community  on  the  various  services  provided  for
them  by  the  State  and  other  organisation  and  to
assist them to derive benefits from such programmes ;
to create awareness among the general public with
regard to the services and assistance required by the
visually  handicapped  community ;

to  make 
appropriate 
efforts 
to 
eliminate
misconceptions and false attitudes prevailing in the
society regarding blindness and blind people ;
to act as a mediator to find solutions to legal issues

confronted 
by 
the 
visually 
handicapped
community ;
to  liaise  with  other  organisations  having  objects
similar  to those the Corporation ;
to raise funds in order to provide necessary welfare
services to the visually handicapped community ;
to act in every possible way to eradicate causes of
blindness  ;
